preRunAmendment.reason: Final read-only delta review found that an empty mismatch set could pass vacuously and that independent shadow position occupancy was not modelled.
changes: Require at least one comparable executed entry and one executed-entry mismatch before attribution can pass.
Treat zero mismatches as insufficient evidence, never a pass.
Remove POSITION_OCCUPANCY_MISMATCH from allowed causes; actual pre-observation position context is held constant and is not an independently measured shadow state.

question: Can every executed-entry mismatch between the unchanged PumpPortal runtime lane and the report-only Helius shadow be attributed to a recorded position, preset-family, guard-eligibility, wallet-context, market-input, or state-age/source difference?

entryMismatchAttribution.passRule: At least one comparable executed ENTRY and at least one executed-entry mismatch must be observed. Every mismatch must then have one deterministic attributed cause. Zero mismatches are insufficient evidence; MISSING_PAIRED_EVALUATION and UNATTRIBUTED are failures.
entryMismatchAttribution.positionStatePolicy: Use the actual pre-observation position context as a held-constant control. No independent shadow position occupancy is modelled, so position occupancy cannot be an attributed provider mismatch.

supersedes.methodologyFinding: Entry mismatches clustered at lane-state transitions, while broad gate agreement remained high. V8 freezes mismatch attribution rather than optimizing the agreement threshold.

nextIfPass: Keep Helius report-only and repeat the attribution result on another valid full-coverage run before proposing any procurement change.
nextIfFail: Fix only the missing comparator instrumentation identified by the unattributed rows. Do not change strategy, freshness bounds, gates, or provider routing.
